propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for oversized comment and description bodies, creating risk that truncation re-emits indefinitely on pass 2
DC's sanitize_comment binds both comment and description limits to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) without documented justification, raising doubt about correctness
Comment and description convergence tests driven through compute_outbound_mutations or _diff_comments may silently resolve Cloud backend from config fallback instead of DC, masking test vacuity

The 32767 character ceiling is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit (covering comments and text fields per jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519) and is correct for DC, requiring only provenance citation not re-measurement

DC convergence tests must inject backend explicitly at all seams (sanitizer for comments, outbound_mapper/inbound_mapper/links for descriptions) and prove injection via identity/recording checks, not value assertions
